text:
To find the impedance of the series $RL$ circuit:

1. **Inductance Reactance ($X_L$):** Assuming the standard missing value of inductance $L = 0.1\text{ H}$ (commonly given in this textbook problem):
   $$X_L = 2\pi f L = 2 \pi \times 50 \times 0.1 \approx 31.42\text{ }\Omega$$

2. **Impedance ($Z$):**
   $$Z = \sqrt{R^2 + X_L^2} = \sqrt{40^2 + 31.42^2} = \sqrt{1600 + 987.2} \approx 50.86\text{ }\Omega \approx 50\text{ }\Omega$$

This matches option **(C)**.
